name: Thumb
overview: The Scriptures reveal the thumb as a significant symbol in the consecration and purification rituals of the Old Testament priesthood. Blood and oil were applied to the thumb of the right hand, alongside the right ear and great toe, during ceremonies of sanctification and cleansing, as seen in the detailed instructions given in Exodus 29 and Leviticus 14. This practice underscores the comprehensive dedication of a person—ear, hand, and foot—to God's service, marking a holistic consecration of the whole individual in covenant relationship with Him.
